QUOTE: "`ServerManager::execute` always checks the deny list." and "With a callback wired, the only thing that stops a call is the deny list."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says ServerManager::execute consults the deny list, and that it is the only thing that stops a call once a callback is wired. That matches the item's substance, though the answer also lists other preconditions (schema, tier, etc.) that can block.
